text:
India's mutual fund rulebook has been rewritten for the first time in 30 years.

The SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations, 2026 were notified in January 2026 and came into force on 1 April 2026, replacing the 1996 Regulations. A Master Circular dated 20 March 2026 brings the existing mutual fund circulars into a single document, so participants no longer need to track them one by one.

On the sponsor side, one of the registration routes requires an AMC net worth of about ₹50 crore.

Our reading: any document or process that still cites the 1996 Regulations is likely due an update. This is an interpretation, not advice.

For those who work with these rules daily, which change has affected your process the most so far?
